summary: This page covers the procedures for connecting shielding gas (100% Argon) and the power cord for the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder.
text_content:
Connect Shielding Gas

1. With assistance, place an 100% Argon cylinder (not included) onto a cabinet or cart near the Welder and secure the cylinder in place with two straps (not included) to prevent tipping.

2. Remove the cylinder's cap. Stand to the side of the valve opening, then open the valve briefly to blow dust and dirt from the valve opening. Close the cylinder valve.

3. Locate the Regulator (included) and close its valve until it is loose, then thread Regulator onto cylinder and wrench-tighten connection.

4. Connect Shielding Gas Hose on TIG Torch Cable Connector to the Regulator's Outlet and wrench-tighten connection.

Briefly open valve to clean, then close valve.

Connect Power Cord

Plug either 120VAC or 240VAC Power Cord into Power Input Socket.

Note: Plug will only fit one way.

WARNING! TO PREVENT SERIOUS INJURY FROM ACCIDENTAL OPERATION: Do not plug cord into wall outlet at this time.

Power Input

Item 57812     For technical questions, please call 1-800-444-3353.     Page 25

key_facts: 100% Argon cylinder is required for shielding gas (not included)
Two straps (not included) are required to secure the gas cylinder to prevent tipping
The regulator is included with the welder
Stand to the side of the valve opening when briefly opening cylinder valve to clean
Regulator valve should be closed (loosened) before threading onto cylinder
Regulator connection must be wrench-tightened onto cylinder
Shielding Gas Hose on TIG Torch Cable Connector connects to Regulator Outlet and must be wrench-tightened
Welder accepts either 120VAC or 240VAC power cord
Power cord plug will only fit one way into Power Input Socket
WARNING: Do not plug cord into wall outlet during setup to prevent accidental operation
This is page 25 of the manual
